serve.human.text: There. One fed and watered. Now it's just us again.
Gone. Good. I was starting to think that one would move in.
You're getting so good at this. At being you.

serve.mimic.text: And off it goes, wearing them like a Sunday shirt. ...What? I'm only saying.
Did you see it hold the door for itself? Lovely manners. Somebody raised that.
You let that one walk. Funny. I'd have thought you of all people would spot it.

turnAway.human.text: Cold. I didn't know you had that in you. ...I like knowing.
They'll be right. The fog's only weather. Mostly.

turnAway.mimic.text: Good eye. You always could pick them. Takes one to... takes a good one.
It'll stand out there a while. They do. Don't wave.

shelter.human.text: They're settled. Don't go back there. I mean it. I'll check on them. Only me.
They can have the cot. But the door stays locked, and the key stays with me.

shelter.mimic.text: You do know what you just asked me to put in the back. ...No. You're tired. Never mind.
It went through that door very willingly. That should worry one of us.

walkout.human.text: You looked too long. People don't like being looked at the way you look at them.
Scared another one off. More of you for me.

break.mimic.text: You didn't need to make it show you. They can't help what's underneath.
Messy. They're so much nicer when you let them keep it on.

sided.text: See? We're good at this. You and me.
Thank you for listening. You always do, in the end.
It's just us up here, Sam. It's better when you remember that.

defied.text: Oh. We're not doing what I said, then.
No, no. Your counter. Your call. I only work here.
You used to trust me. I think. Didn't you?

kind.text: On the house. Listen to you. You've never once offered me a coffee.
You don't have to be that nice to them. They leave. I don't.
Careful. Smile at them like that and they'll take you for a person.

mirror.text: Don't stare into that thing. It only shows what's standing there.
Eyes down here, Sam. Mirrors lie in this light.

hands.text: Their hands, Sam. Not yours. Yours are fine. I checked.
Stop looking at your hands. Please.

keyGive.text: Fine. But I take them through. You stay where I can see you.
All right. Out the back, then. With me. Not you.

keyRefuse.text: No. Not that one. Not back there.

keyInsist.text: ...Give me a minute to tidy up in there first. Don't follow me.

keyBackDown.text: Thank you. I knew you'd see it my way.

poke.text: I'm right here. I'm always right here.
Go on. I'm watching. I like watching you work.
You don't need to check on me, Sam. I'm not going anywhere.

sulk.text: Work it out yourself. You're so good at it.
You don't want my opinion. You've made that plain.
I'm not saying anything. You'd only do the opposite.

devoted.text: Not that one. ...No. All right. For you. Only ever for you.
You know I can't say no to you. Give me the key. I'll take them.
